note: The store listings for Bhava for Business, one app in each store for every business (PRD 10.6). Bhava's name only: no business is named. Every permission the app config asks for is in permissions, and its sentence appears word for word in both descriptions; check.mjs fails otherwise, and on any store limit. Nothing account-specific (developer name, contact email, privacy policy address) is kept here: it is entered in each console.

play.title: Bhava for Business
play.shortDescription: Run your Instagram and Facebook shop: orders, DMs, automations and payments.
play.fullDescription:
Bhava for Business is the app for sellers on Bhava. Everything you can do in the web console, you can do here, so you never need a laptop to run your shop.

Orders
- See new orders as they come in, and confirm cash on delivery orders in one tap.
- Pack, ship and track orders, book couriers and handle returns and refunds.
- Orders stay readable offline; changes wait until you are back online.

Customers and messages
- Answer Instagram and Facebook Messenger messages from one inbox.
- See the conversations that need a person, and reply in your shop's voice.

Automations
- Reply to comments and DMs automatically with your products and links.
- Test an automation before it goes live, and see what it sold.

Catalog and payments
- Add products, photos, stock and prices, or import your catalog.
- Set up payments and cash on delivery. Payment keys are entered after a fresh check and are never shown again.

Insights and alerts
- Follow sales, reach and account health, and get alerts that open the right screen.

More than one business
- Switch between every business you work in, with only that business's data on screen.

Sign in
- Sign in with a WhatsApp code or Google. There are no passwords.

Permissions
- The camera and photo library are used only when you add product photos or your logo.
- Fingerprint or Face ID unlocks the app on this phone; it never replaces your sign-in.
- Notifications tell you about new orders and alerts; you choose which ones and set quiet hours.

You can delete your account in Settings at any time.
